build_LAD_detector: build a LAD knowledge distillation detector with student and teacher backbone, neck, and bbox head configs
extract_teacher_feat: extract teacher model features from input batch images using the teacher backbone and neck
compute_LAD_loss: compute the detection loss using teacher-assisted label assignment for the student model
review_LAD_init: review the LAD detector initialization that builds teacher model components and loads checkpoint weights
summarize_LAD_with_teacher_neck: summarize the LAD with_teacher_neck property that checks if the teacher model has a valid neck module
